spec: SPEC-6 vNext §1 active obligation carry succession
description: The earlier active identity, target, surface, generation, prior epoch, and refusal-event history persist across a later carry. A later order may advance the current event and a retry may change status.

cases.name: retry records failure on same stable obligation
later peer event advances current reference only
intervening peer can add a new local obligation

invalidCases.name: active debt cannot disappear without terminal proof
new obligation cannot claim inherited source identity
earlier refusal event cannot be rewritten
new refusal event cannot be minted under a foreign source
current obligation event cannot remain stale
new local refusal event must become current
